articleTitle: Nondestructive Assessment of the Health State of Lithium-ion Batteries at High Energy States Based on Ripple Perturbations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Considering the numerous influencing factors, a fast and accurate assessment of the health state and lifetime of power batteries is crucial for the subsequent use and recycling of power batteries. In this paper, a method to inject ripple perturbation under steady state of the battery is studied to obtain corresponding feedback information. By obtaining the frequency-phase angle curves at different current amplitudes (40mA, and 100mA) and different SOC conditions (90%, 50%, and 10%), the results show that the absolute value of the phase angle corresponding to the special inflection point of the phase angle in the frequency-phase angle curves gradually increases. This pattern can be used to assess the health state of the battery, further verifying the accuracy of the feedback information obtained by injecting ripple perturbations under steady-state conditions. This nondestructive evaluation method provides an effective solution for monitoring the health state of lithium-ion batteries.

articleTitle: Marine Platform Motion Measurement Technology Based on Micro-Inertial Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the deepening of ocean development, precise measurement of marine platform motion is crucial for safe and efficient operations. To improve the measurement accuracy and stability of marine operation platforms, a technology based on micro-inertial sensors for marine platform motion measurement has been developed. This includes the creation of MEMS (Micro-Elector-Mechanical Systems) measurement benchmark equipment for marine platforms, which enables real-time acquisition of marine platform motion data. Characterized by miniaturization, low cost, low power consumption, and high accuracy, this technology provides a reliable solution for safe operations on marine platforms. In the measurement of marine platform motion, a data online analysis method for wave frequency domain self-learning and real-time sea condition monitoring is designed to address the changing frequency conditions of sea waves. By real-time adjustment of filter parameters to adapt to changes in sea conditions and the design of precise compensation algorithms for the phase and amplitude of frequency signals, adaptive compensation for phase and amplitude errors is achieved, effectively solving the displacement estimation accuracy issues under long-period heave motions.

articleTitle: Application of In-Service Remanufacturing Technology in Metallurgical Equipment under the Background of Intelligent Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Metallurgical equipment is a vital material processing equipment in modern high-tech and national defense construction, which plays an essential role in aerospace, chemical industry, energy and other fields, and is increasingly widely used in daily consumer goods. Remanufacturing in service means upgrading the existing "dumb equipment" on site, so as to coordinate it with the production process and significantly improve its health, energy efficiency and intelligence level. Although metallurgical equipment has been widely used, its intelligent level is relatively low, so it is urgent to remanufacture metallurgical equipment in service. As the basic technology of digital, networked and intelligent development, remote monitoring system plays an increasingly prominent role in the scope of production equipment. Taking the typical titanium production equipment in metallurgical equipment as an example, this study proposes to upgrade the existing offline equipment on site, and designs and develops a remote intelligent online monitoring system. The system monitors the equipment in real time through the network, pushes the information in time, and builds an interconnection platform for real-time management of equipment information. Once the equipment is abnormal, it will provide real-time fault diagnosis report to assist enterprises to repair and verify, and solve the problem of safe operation of equipment.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Harmonic Emission Level in New Energy Stations Based on Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This paper presents a theoretical analysis of the independent component method for separating harmonic sources at the Point of Common Coupling (PCC). The method leverages the independent fluctuations of user-side and system-side harmonic sources to iteratively compute a separation matrix, enabling the extraction of independent signal components from PCC measurement data with high correlation to the source signals. Additionally, the paper discusses the fluctuation method, noting its simplicity but reliance on stable background harmonics and the assumption that all PCC harmonics originate from the user side, which can lead to practical errors. To address these limitations, a data fusion-based harmonic impedance calculation method is proposed, utilizing the Kalman filter. The Kalman filter, with its recursive algorithm and low data storage requirements, effectively eliminates noise and has broad applications in real-time monitoring, intelligent diagnosis, and other fields. The paper concludes with a theoretical flowchart of the data fusion strategy based on the Kalman filter. All manuscript components, including tables and figures, must be in English for publication.

articleTitle: Application Research of Kalman Filter based on Acceleration in High-Precision Control of Robotic Arm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of industrial automation technology, the end effector of industrial robots, as an important component of intelligent manufacturing, has increasingly high performance and precision requirements. The control accuracy and response speed of industrial robots at the end of execution are key to achieving high-precision operations. However, in practical applications, sensor data is often affected by noise and interference, resulting in errors in the accuracy of end control execution, which seriously affects the end response speed and product production efficiency. To address this issue, this paper investigates the Kalman filtering algorithm based on FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) and applies it to the execution end of industrial robots. Through the high parallelism and real-time processing capability of FPGA, the efficient implementation of Kalman filtering algorithm has been achieved. Through theoretical analysis and experimental verification, the superiority of this implementation method in improving processing speed and signal purity has been proved, providing strong support for high-precision operation of industrial robots.

articleTitle: Few-shot Incremental Event Detection Based on Auxiliary Cluster and Feature Transfer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Few-shot incremental event detection refers to continuously learning new event types from the class-incremental data stream when the number of samples is limited. However, as the model continuously learns new event types, its detection capability for old event types declines significantly, ultimately leading to catastrophic forgetting. Existing replay-based methods aim to add some samples of old event types to the sample set of new event types to jointly train the model at the current stage. This approach cannot well represent and preserve the class features of the model, and can only alleviate the catastrophic forgetting problem to a certain extent. To address this issue, we propose two complementary approaches based on distillation: auxiliary cluster and feature transfer. The auxiliary cluster approach utilizes the previous feature space as a reference to extract class-level semantics and adjust the positions of instances in the current feature space, achieving tight clustering. Feature transfer, on the other hand, maximizes the positive transfer of features from similar old classes to new classes by judging the similarity between classes while minimizing the negative transfer to dissimilar old classes. By incorporating auxiliary cluster and feature transfer into two models that have demonstrated excellent performance in few-shot incremental event detection tasks, we have achieved improved model performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed methods in mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

articleTitle: Design of Laboratory Equipment Management Cabinet System Based on STM32 and Wechat Applet
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Aiming at the lack of intelligence,convenience and security in laboratory equipment management, a laboratory equipment management cabinet system based on STM32 and wechat applet was designed. The main structure of the hardware frame is designed with modularization idea, and the temperature and humidity sensor is used to obtain the ambient temperature and humidity data in real time. Access status data of monitoring equipment is obtained by ultrasonic sensor in real time. Using cloud server and wechat applet development platform technology, the terminal data of the device management cabinet was shared with cloud data through wireless network and displayed in real-time in wechat applet. Finally, the intelligence, convenience and safety of the system are verified by the actual field test. The system supports secondary development, can be expanded on the existing basis, can meet the needs of laboratory environment to a certain extent, has a certain application prospect.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Antenna Array Element Misplacement on Direction Finding Results
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This article aims to study the influence of antenna array installation errors on the positioning results in the process of ground radiation source direction finding using aerospace vehicles. By analyzing the impact of installation errors of antenna array on the accuracy of direction finding, the importance of installation errors in the direction finding system is revealed. Through simulation experiments, the laws of the impact of installation accuracy are obtained, and a control range for installation accuracy in practical engineering processes is proposed to enhance the reliability and stability of the direction finding system.

articleTitle: Neural Network-based Prediction Method for Data Center Resource Utilization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This article proposes an innovative prediction model (Fine Tune Transformer, FTTransformer), Intended to improve the prediction accuracy of data center resource utilization time series. FTTransformer adopts an encoder decoder architecture, where the encoder part is based on the Transformer model and trained through a "pre training fine-tuning" transfer learning method. In the pre training stage, Transformer enhances the model's ability to extract semantic features and generalization performance through supervised learning and data augmentation techniques. FTTransformer effectively captures hidden state dependencies in resource usage sequences through attention mechanisms, and passes this information to multi-layer LSTM decoders to achieve accurate sequence prediction. Using Alibaba's publicly available dataset for experimental verification, the results show that FTTransformer exhibits significant advantages compared to other models, particularly achieving performance improvements of 2.13% and 2.3% in RMSE and NSE metrics, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Multi variable Time Series Fault Prediction of Gas Turbine Based on Transformer Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the increasing focus on energy efficiency and safety in industry, gas turbines are widely used as efficient power equipment in industries such as electricity and aviation. However, the complexity and long-term wear and tear of gas turbines increase the risk of failure. Traditional fault detection methods rely on empirical rules and simple statistical models, which make it difficult to capture small changes in multivariate time series data, thereby affecting the accuracy and timeliness of predictions. In recent years, deep learning based fault prediction methods have gradually emerged, especially the Transformer model, which has shown excellent performance in time series analysis due to its self attention mechanism and parallel processing capability. This article explores a Transformer based gas turbine fault prediction method, evaluates its practical application effect through data collection and model validation, and aims to demonstrate its advantages in improving fault prediction accuracy and response speed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Visual Data Interaction Controller for Distribution Automation Terminal
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of debugging, maintenance, installation, joint debugging, and equipment inspection of distribution automation terminals, this paper designs a visual data interaction controller.The device adopts a modular design, mainly composed of MCU module, LCD display module, LED module, key operation module and serial communication module.The data interaction software uses an independent operating system for multitasking synchronous execution.The visual data interaction controller can realize the functions of data visualization, status query and modification, human-machine interaction of distribution automation terminal. It is an important channel for field operation and maintenance personnel to perceive status and functional maintenance of distribution automation terminal equipment, and can effectively improve the maintenance convenience of distribution automation terminal.

articleTitle: A Robust Two-factor Medical Sensor Authentication Protocol Based on PUF
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: An extension of the Internet of Things (IoT) in the medical field, medical sensor networks allow medical staff to use mobile devices to access data from sensors on patients so that doctors can plan more effective treatments. The security of the data collected by sensors and transmitted to physicians is challenged, which is vulnerable to physical attacks. In this paper, we propose a two-factor medical sensor authentication protocol based on elliptic curve and PUF, which does not need to store any secret information in the sensor, to resist sensor capture attacks and physical attacks. To verify the safety of the protocol, we utilize the ROR model for analysis, and in addition, we compare the security and communication costs of the protocol with the relevant protocols, demonstrating that the protocol has superior security.

articleTitle: Simulation and Fault Analysis of the DC Charging Control Pilot Circuit Based on National Charging System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The new generation of high-power charging standards for electric vehicles — the 2015+ (national charging system standard) — has released a draft for public consultation. Compared to the previous standard, the 2015+ not only enhances the stability and safety of the charging process but also significantly increases the charging power, catering to a more diverse range of charging scenarios. This paper will delve into the simulation study of the backward compatibility of the control pilot circuit based on the 2015+ standard. By conducting a comprehensive analysis of the voltage signals of the pilot circuit under normal operating conditions and in the event of a PE (protective earth) disconnection fault, this study provides empirical references and theoretical support for the technological advancement in the automotive industry. Through simulation, we can gain insights into the performance of the pilot circuit under various operating states, thereby offering data support for the optimization of charging technology and the enhancement of the reliability and safety of the charging system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Data-Free Extraction Models Based on Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Knowledge distillation is an effective method for compressing deep neural networks. However, in many cases, people are unable to access the raw data due to restrictions on user data privacy, data confidentiality, or data transmission. Existing data-free knowledge distillation methods only use a single teacher model for biased feature statistics, resulting in diversity and poor generalization compared to the original data. As a solution to this problem, this paper proposes a generative deep contrastive inversion algorithm that trains an image generator solely through pre-trained models to generate samples of old classes, enabling data acquisition in data-free scenarios. This algorithm improves discrimination among samples of the same class by introducing additional discriminators to assess and penalize the similarity between reconstructed data. It mitigates the issue of single-styled image reconstruction in existing deep inversion techniques and further enhances the knowledge transfer capability of reconstructed data. For various data-free knowledge distillation tasks, training the image generator once is sufficient for generalization across different model training scenarios.

articleTitle: Prediction of MiRNA-Disease Association Based on Graph Convolution and Multi-Label Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: MicroRNA(miRNA) is a class of non-coding single-stranded RNA molecules encoded by endogenous genes with a length of about 22 nucleotides. Current studies have confirmed a causal relationship between miRNA dysregulation and cancer. To apply miRNA in disease treatment, it is essential to accurately understand the correlation between miRNAs and diseases. However, the number of miRNA-disease correlations confirmed by biotechnology remains limited. Furthermore, validating these associations through biological experiments can be both time-intensive and costly. Therefore, using computational methods to assist biological experiments holds significant practical value.Most current studies on miRNA and diseases focus on determining whether miRNAs can be associated with diseases. Recent research indicates that miRNAs can influence the same disease through multiple mechanisms. Therefore, this paper transforms such prediction problems into multi-label classification tasks. Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) have been widely used in the field of bioinformatics. Consequently, this paper combines GCN with multi-label classification for predicting miRNA-disease association types.

articleTitle: Application of Physically Isolated Optical Network in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This paper introduces the network structure and communication requirements of the distribution network. The production control area includes safety zone I and safety zone II. The management information area includes security area III and security area IV. The network isolation of these security zones provides effective protection for network security. With the rapid development of modern distribution networks, higher requirements are placed on the flexible configuration of networks. A dual-plane isolation switch based on industrial Ethernet is proposed. Combined with wavelength division multiplexing technology, two isolated networks can be operated with one set of equipment without occupying additional space in the distribution cabinet, and secure control access and automated operation and maintenance of the entire network can be achieved with the help of the SDN controller.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Question Answering Method for Large Models Based on Thinking Chain in Power Supply Service Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the tremendous success of Transformer models in the field of natural language processing, large models still face bottlenecks in solving complex inference tasks. This article is based on the power supply service scenario, and proposes a large model intelligent question answering method that can be applied to special scenarios of power supply services, based on CoT and RAG. The method is divided into three stages: problem recognition and rewriting, precise text fragment extraction, and standard answer generation. The open source model Qwen2-72B is used to achieve 98.05% correct reference file recall and 85.12% accurate answer rate through keyword recognition, high-quality rewriting, and rough recall and rearrangement of reference text.

articleTitle: Research on the Structural Design of Collaborative Robot Based on Matlab
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: As a type of robot capable of human-machine collaboration within a certain space, collaborative robots, compared to traditional industrial robots, possess safety and flexibility, being adaptable to various environments and tasks. They find extensive applications in industries such as healthcare, logistics, and education. This article focuses on modular joint design, selecting servo motors and reducers through calculations based on market demands and robot design principles, to complete the design of the robot's arms, joint housings, and flanges. Finite element analysis of the robot's main parts is conducted to ensure the structural reliability of the collaborative robot. Subsequently, based on the robot's structural design, kinematic analysis is performed using D-H parameters to analyze forward and inverse kinematics, examining parameter variations of each joint during motion and validating the correctness of the robot's kinematics.

articleTitle: Parallel Collision Detection Algorithm Based on Pipeline Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This paper presents a parallel collision detection algorithm based on pipeline technology. The partition strategy is adopted to establish the collision detection queue, the processor is allocated by means of cyclic rotation, and the collision queue allocation process is allocated through the pipeline technology. The detection tree is divided in a recursive way, dividing a large problem into sub-problems with the same form as the original problem until no further decomposition is needed, and the task results are incrementally merged with a larger task until no merging is required. The comparative experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can shorten the detection time and improve the detection efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Thermal Safety Characteristics of Ternary Lithium-ion Power Battery at Variable Ambient Temperature
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the rapid popularization of new energy vehicles, traffic accidents caused by thermal runaway of power batteries are gradually increasing. Therefore, in-depth research on their thermal safety characteristics has become an urgent issue at present. This article studies the thermal safety characteristics of ternary lithium-ion power batteries under different environmental temperatures by simulating extreme heat source scenarios that new energy vehicles may encounter. By building a highly integrated visual experimental platform, real-time recording and analysis of the temperature and voltage dynamic changes of the power battery module during the heating process, and recording the entire process to capture the details of thermal runaway events. The results show that environmental temperature has a significant impact on the thermal safety performance of ternary lithium-ion power batteries: at low temperatures. By deepening the understanding of the relationship between the thermal safety performance of ternary lithium-ion power batteries and environmental factors, it can provide important data support and theoretical basis for the new energy vehicle industry in battery thermal management, thermal protection design, and safety standard formulation, which is of great significance for improving the overall safety of new energy vehicles.

articleTitle: High-Gain-Low-RCS PRS Antenna with Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In this paper, two types of metasurface are used for reducing radar cross section (RCS) of antenna. The PCM unit achieves polarization conversion ratio (PCR) of 90% with a relative bandwidth of 104%. The Partially reflecting surface (PRS) antenna is designed with the PCM to create the high– gain-low-RCS antenna. Furthermore, a radar absorbing material (RAM) is proposed to reduce the in-band RCS of PRS antenna and expand the RCS reduction (RCSR) bandwidth. The RCSR of the designed antenna with metasurface is 10dB from 10GHz to 35GHz under normal incidence, which means a relative bandwidth of 111%.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv8 Yellow Hat Wearing Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Aiming at the safety of primary school students, we have researched and implemented an automatic detection system for primary school students wearing yellow hats based on the improved YOLOv8 algorithm. The paper analyzes some shortcomings of the YOLOv8 algorithm and proposes improvements. The system adopts the PyTorch framework and is developed through steps such as data collection, annotation, model training, and prediction, achieving real-time detection of images, videos, and cameras. The test results indicate that the model performs well in detecting the wearing of small yellow hats. The average detection accuracy reached 0.669, and it has good adaptability under various environmental conditions. This system not only effectively saves human resources, but also enhances the safety awareness of primary school students. Future research can further optimize model performance and combine it with machine vision technology for deployment in practical applications.

articleTitle: Virtualization Of Network Device Based On Xen Hypervisor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The full-virtualization model of Xen ARM implements device virtualization based on data access exceptions, and does not capture complete instructions, which produces incorrect simulation results when simulating complex devices. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a full-virtualization model for network devices based on instruction emulation. The basic idea of this model is to parse the complete content of the instruction according the processor manual and use software to simulate the instruction operation; then provide guest operating systems with the same interface as real network devices, allowing virtual machines to transparently access the devices. And the purpose of this model is to fully utilize the hardware virtualization technology provided by ARM, so that the guest operating system can use the network device without modification and without relying on the functions provided by Linux. In the last part of the article, network device virtualization model based on Xen Hypervisor are implemented and the analysis and summary are carried out.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis and Method Research on the Post-Evaluation of Power Grid Technology Projects
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: By re-examining, re-checking and effectively feeding back the whole process of science and technology projects, it helps to optimize the management level of the whole process of science and technology projects and promote the development of power science and technology innovation. The article focuses on the research focus of post-evaluation of power grid science and technology projects, and develops according to the research idea of "index system construction-evaluation model research-empirical analysis-countermeasure suggestion". First of all, the index system is constructed around the four aspects of technology level, advanced applicability and influence, comprehensive benefit and application promotion. Secondly, DEMATAL is used to assign the indexes, and then PROMETHEE-II method is combined to carry out post-evaluation and empirical analysis of the grid science and technology project to determine the final evaluation results.

articleTitle: Color Distorted Underwater Images Restoration Based on Distorted Frames Reconstruction and Multi-Scale Fushion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: When light propagates through the uneven surfaces of transparent media such as glass, crystal, and water, its path becomes highly complex. Among these, the complex reflection and refraction caused by water surface fluctuations present one of the most challenging issues in the field of cross-media imaging. In this paper, we propose a color cross-media distortion image restoration method based on two blocks. The distorted frames reconstruction can effectively remove distortions from the input sequence. Then, multi-scale fusion is used to get better image quality. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can achieve distortion correction and color restoration of color cross-media distorted images, and obtain better visual quality while preserving the image structure.

articleTitle: Design and application of electric power dispatching intelligent management system based on digital warehouse
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the development of National Science and Technology and the rapid development of electric power company, the automation level of electric power dispatching is getting higher and higher in smart grid, and the automatic control of electric power grid is realized by using control system, it can effectively improve the production efficiency and power supply reliability of power enterprises. Therefore, the thesis has carried on the research from the software, the hardware disposition, the correlation design and the improvement and so on.

articleTitle: Digital Measurement Methods of OBD Diagnostic Apparatus for Motor Vehicle Emissions Inspection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: To guarantee the accuracy and reliability of the measurement value of the diagnostic apparatus of On-Board Diagnostics (OBD) for motor vehicle emission inspection, and to enhance the metrological technical support for motor vehicle emission supervision, a digital measurement method was proposed. Firstly, the definition, composition and application overview of OBD diagnostic apparatus for motor vehicle emission inspection were introduced, and the current status of digital metrology was elaborated. The digital measurement method of OBD diagnostic apparatus for motor vehicle emission inspection was discussed, covering aspects such as real-time data stream calibration methods, calibration device traceability methods, and uncertainty evaluation. Finally, three conclusions were obtained through the demonstration: (1) the proposed measurement method aligns with the actual working conditions of OBD diagnostic apparatus, which is scientific, reasonable and operable; (2) the reasonableness of the traceability method of the calibration device is demonstrated by the uncertainty analysis of the standard value of the data flow written in the calibration device, the formulation of the physical indexes among the diagnostic connectors' pins under different protocols, and the reading test of the standard OBD test device, and the real-time data flow error measurement results are given after the evaluation; (3) the uncertainty of the measurement result of the data flow indication error was given, which can meet the requirements of the volume transmission.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic System Modeling and Intervention Strategies Based on Integral Sliding Mode Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The sliding mode control strategy enables the controlled system to not only maintain robustness against uncertainties and the ability to reject external disturbances in the sliding mode, but also achieve superior dynamic performance. Therefore, it holds great potential for addressing both linear and nonlinear systems in uncertain and disturbed environments. At present, it has been widely applied in various fields such as power electronic systems, servo systems, life science systems, economic operation and development systems, among others. This paper proposes a time-varying model for dynamic systems under complex disturbance environments, designs a rational integral sliding mode controller to ensure optimal output configuration of the model, and provides a proof of the stability of the integral sliding mode controller based on the Lyapunov framework. Through a detailed analysis of a specific case, the correctness and robustness of the proposed control strategy are verified.

articleTitle: Research on the Automatic Loading and Unloading Control Technology of Industrial Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The combination application of vertical machining centers, CNC lathes, and FANUC industrial robots has significantly improved the efficiency of CNC machining on the motor casing processing production line. Designed automatic loading and unloading mechanisms for robots and automatic stacking mechanisms for processed products, analyzed the I/O interface applications and CC-LINK bus connections of FANUC industrial robots, PLC, and CNC machine tools.

articleTitle: Intertrochanteric Fracture Image Detection Using Grad-CAM and YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Advancements in deep learning have notably enhanced smart medical care, particularly in diagnosing and classifying intertrochanteric fractures—a common hip fracture in the elderly characterized by numerous and irregularly shaped fragments, which often leads to a high misdiagnosis rate. This article introduces a detection method using the YOLOv5 model integrated with a gradient class activation map to intelligently detect intertrochanteric fractures and improve diagnostic efficiency. The study involved 774 X-ray images, divided into 510 with intertrochanteric fractures and 264 normal images. A set of 633 X-rays was selected randomly for training. Experimental results show that the YOLOv5 model achieved a Mean Average Precision (MAP) of 97% and a detection accuracy of 94% for intertrochanteric fractures. The performance of the YOLOv5 model was superior in this context compared to the Faster RCNN model under similar conditions, demonstrating its effectiveness in distinguishing between fractured and normal cases.

articleTitle: Optimization of Sheet Material Layout in Industrial Production Using Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In industrial production, sheet material layout is a critical issue that directly impacts manufacturing efficiency and costs. Although various optimization methods exist, traditional layout algorithms often struggle to handle complex production requirements and constraints. Therefore, a more effective method is needed to address this problem. This study aims to explore the use of genetic algorithms (GA) to optimize sheet material layout, improving production efficiency and reducing costs. By combining the global search capabilities of genetic algorithms with the specific constraints of the sheet material layout problem, we aim to propose a more effective layout scheme. We have designed a sheet material layout optimization model based on genetic algorithms, transforming the sheet material layout problem into an optimization problem of a fitness function. The model considers sheet dimensions, shapes, quantities, and production equipment constraints, and optimizes the layout through genetic operations such as selection, crossover, and mutation. This paper focuses on introducing genetic algorithms into the layout of irregular sheet materials to reduce material waste during cutting and enhance production efficiency.

articleTitle: Research and design of intelligent estimation method of EV Vs based on multiple Kalman filters
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Vehicle dynamics simulation technology is widely used in the development process of intelligent vehicle control algorithm. On the one hand, vehicle dynamics simulation can be applied to the initial verification of the control algorithm, and test the effectiveness of the algorithm before the real vehicle experiment to save the time and cost; on the other hand, vehicle dynamics simulation is also used for the optimization design of the control algorithm parameters. Researchers use the simulation technology to construct the controller evaluation training environment and optimize the controller parameters repeatedly<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1],[2]</sup>. It is a key problem to improve the accuracy of the state estimation algorithm. The model-based state estimation methods mainly include Kalman filter, extended Kalman filter, traceless Kalman filter and volume Kalman filter<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[3],[6]</sup>. In this paper, we establish a vehicle dynamics simulation model based on the above mechanism, analyze the advantages and disadvantages of various Kalman filtering algorithms, and verify the algorithm, which improves the accuracy and intelligence of electric vehicle state estimation in the future. According to the analysis of the experiment results, the accuracy of the trace Kalman filter algorithm and the volume Kalman algorithm based on the seven DoF model is higher than that of the extended Kalman filter, and the volume Kalman filter algorithm and the estimation performance of the pendulum angle velocity and center of mass offset angle, which is improved compared with the extended Kalman filter performance.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Different Calibration Plate Experiments of Percutaneous Jaundice Meters Based on the Origin Software
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Origin is a powerful data analysis and processing and scientific mapping software, which plays an important role in scientific research. This paper introduces the working principle of the percutaneous jaundice meters. Through the cross test of five different percutaneous jaundice meters with their own calibration plates, the calibration results were analyzed and observed by Origin software, and the experimental data are linearly fitted and plotted. The results showed that the measured values of the manufacturer's own calibration plate are in good agreement with the nominal values. When different brands of jaundice meters measured the same calibration plate, the differences between the measured value and the nominal value of the calibration plates were statistically significant (α=0.05, P ≦ 0.05).When measuring different human skins, the differences between different jaundice meters were small. The experiment shows that using Origin software to process experimental data is simple, fast and intuitive, which avoids the error caused by human factors and can provide some help in data analysis.

articleTitle: Determination of Copper Ion by Electrochemical Sensor Based on L-Cysteine/Chitosan
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: A novel type of L-cysteine and chitosan-modified glassy carbon electrode was fabricated in this study as an electrochemical sensor for the determination of copper (II). Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) and cyclic voltammetry (CV) were employed to investigate the electrochemical performance of the sensor. This electrochemical sensor exhibited excellent electrocatalytic activity towards copper (II) in a pH 4.2 acetate buffer solution. The calibration curve obtained from linear scanning voltammetry (LSV) showed a linear increase in peak current with increasing copper (II) concentration within the range of 1.0×10-8 to 1.0×10 -4 mol/L, described by the equation I(μA)= -1.192 + 0.4683c(μmol/L), with a high correlation coefficient of 0.99847 and a detection limit of 5.3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> mol/L. The modified electrode demonstrated good stability, reproducibility, and selectivity.

articleTitle: Security Vulnerability Detection Technology in Computer Software
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: All Modern information technology has been integrated into various fields, which can not only achieve efficient storage of a large amount of information data, but also become more and more stable. However, the security vulnerabilities in computer software are becoming more and more complex and difficult to deal with, which requires more advanced detection technology to quickly find the causes of vulnerabilities, timely remedy security defects, and ensure that computer software is always in normal operation. Based on this, this paper discusses the characteristics of security vulnerabilities in computer software, analyze computer software security vulnerability detection technology, the application of security vulnerability detection technology in computer software is proposed.

articleTitle: Preparation and Application of Chitosan in Bioelectrochemical Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In recent years, sensors made of chitosan have become a research hotspot due to their advantages of low cost, simple preparation process, rapid response and high sensitivity. In this paper, the preparation method of chitosan sensor and its application in bioelectrochemical sensors are introduced, and its application prospect is prospected.

articleTitle: Application of UAV Intelligent Inspection in Photovoltaic Power Station
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With increasing capacity of solar power, number of photovoltaic panel faults are rising. Based on this,the operation of solar power station is becoming more and more important. Photovoltaic power station usually covers a large area with numbers of solar arrays. There is not enough workers to check all station facilities. This have bad impact on Photovoltaic power station as the solar arrays will occur many faults. For solving this problem, a method using unmanned aerial vehicle nest and artificial intelligence operation system is proposed.

articleTitle: Application of Sqlmap in SQL injection vulnerability detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Network security has been paid more and more attention, in which SQL injection vulnerability detection and repair is an important research direction. Based on Sqlmap software, the detection of database injection vulnerabilities is studied, the installation and use of Sqlmap are analyzed in detail, and suggestions for the defense and reinforcement of SQL injection vulnerabilities are put forward.

articleTitle: The Application of Big Data and Artificial Intelligence Technology in Football Training and Competition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, the application of big data and artificial intelligence (AI) in sports is becoming more and more extensive, providing new perspectives and methods for football teaching and training. AI and big data collect and analyze a large amount of data and then build models, which can be used to evaluate the level of football players, formulate technical and develop training strategies. This article analyzes cases in order to explore how to use big data and AI to optimize football training, competition, and refereeing. Practical suggestions can also be put forward through the difficulties faced by big data and artificial intelligence technology. Finally, with these technologies, football will develop into a scientific, intelligent, and popular future.

articleTitle: Surgical Robot Radiation Emission Detection and Rectification Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The surgical robot is an automatic high-tech medical device with programmable capabilities. It assists doctors who are far away from the operating table to complete surgical operations by providing precise, stable and minimally invasive operations. Its complex structure easily causes radiation values to exceed the standard. This article analyzes the situation where the radiation emission test results exceed the standard in electromagnetic compatibility testing and takes different rectification measures to help solve the problem of excessive radiation emission of surgical robots.

articleTitle: Research on Ant Colony Intelligence Algorithm for InSAR and GPS Subsidence Monitoring Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the development of various surveying techniques for detecting variational surface activities from different perspectives, integrating and fusing multi-sensor observations has become the key to improve monitoring accuracy. In this paper, we propose an ant colony intelligence scheme to optimize the weighted fusion of interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR) and Global Positioning System(GPS) observations for monitoring surface deformation in alpine canyon areas. First, the ground subsidence data are extracted by small baseline subset interferometric synthetic aperture radar(SBAS-InSAR) and by post-processing differential GPS(DGPS). Secondly, we develop the ant colony algorithm to find the optimal combination of fusion weights for multi-sensor observation. Finally, the proposed ant colony fusion algorithm is compared with traditional fusion algorithms, such as (Ensemble Kalman Filter)EnKF and particle filter algorithm. The research results show that the ant colony fusion algorithm can significantly improve the accuracy and reliability of surface subsidence monitoring. The research results are expected to provide a new data processing strategy for surface subsidence monitoring in alpine canyon areas, and contribute certain empirical research to the development of multi-source data fusion technology.

articleTitle: Implementation of Electromagnetic Compatibility Emission Detection Method for Rehabilitation Training Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Rehabilitation training robots have been widely used in nursing, assisting limb motor function recovery and other training. With advanced intelligent modules, they can effectively analyze the training data of service recipients, better provide personalized rehabilitation training services for service recipients, and objectively and quantitatively evaluate the training effect. This article introduces the basic knowledge of rehabilitation training robots, explains the detection methods and precautions for electromagnetic compatibility emissions of rehabilitation training robot products, and analyzes the necessity for products to meet electromagnetic compatibility emission requirements.

articleTitle: Network Traffic Correlation Based on Multi-Round Statistical Feature Approximation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This paper presents an network traffic correlation method using multi-round statistical feature approximation. By conducting multiple rounds of traffic collection and analysis under different network configurations, the method significantly improves the accuracy and precision of traffic correlation. Compared to traditional single-round methods, this approach is more robust and adaptable in complex network environments, particularly against traffic obfuscation techniques. Experiments in anonymous networks like Mixnet show that this method performs effectively across various configurations. The combination of multi-round sampling with statistical feature approximation reduces single-sampling errors and enhances correlation reliability. While challenges remain with highly complex obfuscation techniques, future work will focus on improving robustness and applicability. This method provides a valuable solution for cybersecurity, enhancing traffic correlation accuracy and supporting network monitoring and security auditing.

articleTitle: Security Vulnerability Detection Method of Open-source Software Based on Graph Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the popularity of open source software, software security problems have become increasingly prominent. Traditional vulnerability detection methods are no longer able to cope with today’s complex virus vulnerabilities, and the detection results often have certain limitations. Therefore, an open source software security vulnerability detection method based on graph attention network is proposed. Firstly, the graph attention network model is constructed, and the source code detection is used to identify and detect the graph attention vulnerability. In order to verify the performance of the graph attention network model in the proposed method, the paper compares the proposed model with Drebin algorithm. The results show that the graph attention network model can effectively detect the number of security vulnerabilities in open source software, and its maximum error value is 4. Compared with Drebin algorithm, the security vulnerability detection method has higher accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research and Application of 3D Terrain Modeling for Landslide Deposit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This research develops a 3D model to render the deposit terrain after the Baige landslide disaster took place on October 10, 2018. The particle-based method is directly utilized for rendering the accumulation surface. Techniques for tracking and visualizing the free surface, such as point splatting and marching cubes-based surface reconstruction, are introduced in this study. The findings from the landslide simulation experiments indicate that the approach presented in this paper is both efficient and applicable for 3D terrain optimization modeling in landslide scenarios. The findings reveal that the model can accurately represent the thickness, geometric shape, and cross-sectional characteristics of the accumulation body. These results lay a technical foundation and serve as a reference for the planning of subsequent emergency construction and the formulation of disaster prevention and mitigation strategies.

articleTitle: Research on path planning of mobile robot based on improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: with the development of robot technology, the application of mobile robot is more and more extensive. Path planning is very important when the robot performs tasks. The improved ant colony algorithm with smooth function and multi-objective evaluation function can improve the convergence speed and path quality of the algorithm. Experiments in 20x20 grid environment show that the proposed algorithm has shorter path, smaller turning angle and smoother, and faster convergence speed. This proves the superiority of the improved ant colony algorithm in mobile robot path planning.

articleTitle: Research on the Cooling Water Chamber Structure of OP2S Engine Based on Taguchi Algorithm-Signal to Noise Ratio Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In response to the complex structure of the cooling water chamber in opposed piston two-stroke engines, which has adverse effects on the flow of cooling water, a Taguchi algorithm-signal to noise ratio analysis-based optimization method for the cooling water chamber structure parameters is proposed. The experimental parameters include the diameter of the exhaust outlet water channel, the outer diameter of the exhaust side water chamber, and the outer diameter of the combustion chamber water chamber. Orthogonal experiments are designed, with the maximum pressure difference, maximum flow rate difference, and maximum turbulent kinetic energy of the cooling water as evaluation indicators, by analyzing the signal-to-noise ratio and range of simulation results, the optimal combination of cooling water chamber structural parameters is obtained. The optimization results show that the optimal structural parameters of the cooling water chamber are the diameter of the exhaust port waterway of 3.5mm, the outer diameter of the exhaust side water chamber of 75mm, and the outer diameter of the combustion chamber water chamber of 72mm. Compared with the initial plan, the cooling water flow characteristics are effectively optimized.

articleTitle: Non Synchronous Harmonic State Estimation Strategy Based on Pseudo Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This paper introduces a method for harmonic state estimation using non-synchronous measurement data from China's Power Quality Measurement System (PQMS). To synchronize this data, the paper proposes phase angle error compensation and a non-synchronous phase compensation technique using redundant virtual and pseudo-measurements, enhancing network observability. A hybrid algorithm combining chaotic particle swarm optimization and quasi-Newton optimization is employed to solve the harmonic state estimation model. Simulations using the IEEE 14-bus benchmark system and practical engineering cases validate the method's feasibility and effectiveness, achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. The proposed approach can help power companies identify locations for adding PQMDs, improving power quality management and harmonic issue allocation. Future research directions include improving pseudo-measurement accuracy, enhancing solution speed, and exploring the impact of other disturbance factors on model stability. These advancements could significantly improve power quality monitoring and analysis, leading to more effective strategies for managing harmonic distortion in electrical systems.

articleTitle: Design of water saving control system for corn field based on STC89C52
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This paper aims at the problem that water resources cannot be fully utilized in irrigation, and designs a water-saving control system for corn fields based on STC89C52. With the STC89C52 single-chip microcomputer as the main control core, the online monitoring of the size of the irrigation water flow is completed to achieve precise irrigation of crops. From the perspective of practical application, the system design is completed. The water level value in the farmland or canal is taken as the main parameter to determine whether the corn field is short of water. By collecting the changes in the growth environment in the farmland, users can control and adjust at any time. If the system detects that the farmland lacks water, the WIFI module will send a message to the mobile phone APP to remind the user. After the user reads the message, they can remotely control the gate switch quantity and the size of the water flow to meet the demand for water-saving control of the corn field.

articleTitle: Design of Compact Circularly Polarized Microstrip Antenna Loaded with Parasitic Patches and Slotted Ground
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This article proposes a novel center-feed circularly polarized (CP) antenna with four arrow parasitic patches and a slotted ground plane. Two pairs of narrow rectangular slots with varying lengths are symmetrically embedded in a square ground plane for CP radiation. By appropriately adjusting the lengths of the narrow slots, good CP radiation and impedance matching are attained. The designed antenna operates in the L1 band of the GPS navigation system (1575.42 MHz). The designed antenna patch size is 0.12λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>×0.12λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>, and the maximum gain in the vertical direction is measured at 5.62 dBi. The GPS antenna was designed and analysed by using CST Studio software for simulation. Simulation results indicate that the 10 dB return loss bandwidth is 46MHz (1543-1589 MHz), 2.92%, and the 3 dB axial ratio (AR) bandwidth is 12 MHz, 0.8%. In addition, the antenna has a 3 dB AR beamwidth of approximately 194 °, suitable for omnidirectional reception of satellite signals on vehicle platforms.

articleTitle: Integrating LSTM and EnKF Algorithms for InSAR and GPS Monitoring Data Assimilation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) and Global Position System (GPS) are two commonly used methods for continuous monitoring of surface displacement, each with its own unique advantages. The traditional data assimilation method is insufficient for the processing of nonlinear time series data, and difficult to add indirect influencing variables. In this paper we integrate the Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network with the traditional ensemble Kalman(EnKF) algorithm for data assimilation. Based on EnKF algorithm, the multi-input LSTM model is used as the prediction model for forward reasoning, meanwhile an indirect influencing variable rainfall is added into LSTM model to improve the accuracy. Through the experimental and comparative analysis of the subsidence monitoring data of InSAR and GPS from September 2021 to January 2024, the results show that the proposed assimilation method has achieved more accurate than traditional EnKF and LSTM.

articleTitle: A Vehicle Reversing Assistance Positioning Algorithm Based on Dual-Camera Calibration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: To address the issue of insufficient positioning accuracy in current digital image processing methods used for assisting vehicle parking, a vehicle reversing assistance positioning algorithm based on dual-camera calibration is proposed. This algorithm first generates a bird's-eye view by applying a perspective transformation to the camera images, thereby obtaining a global perspective of the vehicle's reversing environment. Next, A chessboard calibration pattern is used to match pixel distances with actual distances in the bird's-eye view, establishing a precise conversion relationship between the image coordinate system and the ground coordinate system. Subsequently, red landmark lines in the bird's-eye view are identified, and edge points are extracted. The least squares method is then applied to fit the edge points for line detection, obtaining the landmark line. The midpoint of the landmark line is calculated using the endpoints of the line, and the distance between this midpoint and the camera's optical center is determined in the bird's-eye view. Finally, Based on the angle and distance of the midpoint, the spatial positioning relationship between the vehicle and the parking space is calculated, enabling precise vehicle reversing positioning. The experimental results show that the maximum deviation during the reversing process does not exceed 1cm during the reversing process, demonstrating this method's effectiveness in achieving accurate vehicle positioning.

articleTitle: Global Semantic Attention in CNNs for Fracture Image Detection and Recognition in the IoE
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a simple and accurate global semantic attention mechanism based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). To validate its credibility, a total of 788 cases of normal and fractured distal radius images were collected and processed. The credibility of the algorithm was evaluated through analysis of metrics such as Positive Predictive Value (PPV), Negative Predictive Value (NPV), sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy. The final experimental results demonstrate that with improved image quality and the advantages of the algorithm model, the experiment achieved an accuracy rate of 93.04%. This indicates that the Faster R-CNN distal radius fracture detection model, incorporating higher-order global representations, can achieve effective diagnostic identification with high credibility.

articleTitle: Measurement System Of Deep Hole Straightness Based On Computer Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This paper addresses the complexity of devices and operations in deep hole straightness measurement and the lengthy calculation methods for straightness evaluation. A deep-hole straightness measurement system based on computer control is proposed. Based on the principle of the opposite measurement method, a deep hole straightness measurement device was designed, achieving stable operation and data collection within the deep hole. The least squares method was used to evaluate the straightness of deep hole parts. A deep hole straightness measurement test platform was built, achieving measurement accuracy within 0.1/1000. The test results show that the measurement system has advantages such as simple device, easy operation, wide applicability, and high measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Bench Dragon Motion Simulation Based on Fourth-order RK Algorithm and ABM Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In this paper, a motion simulation model based on the approximate solution of differential equations is proposed for the complex spiral trajectory problem associated with the traditional Chinese folk custom "bridge lamp". The two-end hybrid algorithm is based on the fourth-order Runge-Kutta method and Adams-Bashforth-Moulton method. On this basis, a detailed two-level collision detection model is proposed for the possible collision phenomena in this process. It is based on the improved Gilbert-Johnson-Keerthi algorithm based on bounding box as a pre-screening algorithm support and Separating Axis Theorem algorithm as a complex screening algorithm support. Through the mathematical modelling and processing of the mathematical problems, we can further extend to the advanced track design applications such as roller coasters, sightseeing trains, etc. Furthermore, we can guide the motion governed by complex differential equations and the multi-sided graph collision detection problems associated with it, for the sake of provide a reference for the processing of similar motion problems.

articleTitle: Development of Low-Frequency Standard Voltage Transformer Equipment for Field Use
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Voltage transformers need to be adapted to 15-30Hz environment in flexible low-frequency transmission, and it is difficult for existing technologies to meet the accuracy requirements. Domestic and foreign low-frequency power traceability system is not perfect, affecting power transmission safety and trade settlement. It is necessary to research and develop low-frequency standard voltage transformer and calibration technology to support the construction of traceability system and ensure the stability and fairness of flexible low-frequency power transmission. In response to these problems, a low-frequency standard voltage transformer with good performance has been developed for on-site use. In order to meet the field calibration use, designed with good performance indicators of low-frequency standard voltage transformer key technical parameters and the overall structure, comprehensive comparison of a variety of materials, in the high magnetic potential, high initial permeability to seek a balance between the window size of the appropriate choice of ultra-microcrystalline iron core. In order to solve the interference problem, double shielding design was adopted in reducing the reception sensitivity of low-frequency standard voltage transformer. Finally, and completed the field calibration with low-frequency standard voltage transformer prototype development.

articleTitle: Four-Axis Computerized Numerical Control Milling of Flanges at Both Ends of the Piston Cylinder Housing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: To address the issues of low processing efficiency and poor processing accuracy in the three-axis milling of the flanges at both ends of the piston cylinder housing, this paper adopts a four-axis milling method. First, a milling-specific fixture was designed for the piston cylinder housing. Next, the four-axis milling process of the flanges at both ends of the piston cylinder housing was developed and validated by computerized numerical control simulation. Finally, the four-axis milling of the flanges at both ends of the piston cylinder housing was achieved through machining experiments. The experimental results show that the four-axis milling of the piston cylinder housing effectively solves the problems of low processing efficiency, poor processing accuracy, and the tendency to produce joint marks in the flange processing at both ends of the piston cylinder housing.

articleTitle: Analysis and Characterization of Operation Resilience in Distribution Network with High Proportion Distributed Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: After the large integration of distributed photovoltaic (PV) in the distribution network, a series of power quality issues are triggered, leading to a decrease in operation resilience. Consequently, sensitive loads may fail to operate normally or experience interruptions, resulting in significant economic losses. To characterize the impact of distributed PV on the operation resilience of the distribution network, this paper proposes a method that utilizes the power quality index to construct a trapezoidal curve for operation resilience assessment. Subsequently, theoretical analysis of the influence of distributed PV on power quality is conducted. Finally, through simulations conducted in MATLAB and OpenDSS, this paper verifies the impact of distributed PV on resilience under different cases. Suggestions for improving the operation resilience of the distribution network are also presented for power companies during the planning phase.

articleTitle: Research on The Planning of Police Patrol Line Based on Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In the public security work, the line inspection is an important work. To make the patrol route planning more reasonable, we utilize ant colony optimization to optimize the patrol path. The experimental results demonstrate that the ant colony algorithm meets the requirements for path planning. Using the ant colony optimization can save time and the path is shorter. Therefore, the effectiveness of the algorithm has been proven.

articleTitle: Status Assessment of Substation Grounding System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In order to better assess the status of the grounding system in the operating power generation and substation, this article first constructs a grounding system status assessment system, which includes four aspects: the health status of the grounding system, the status of the grounding system under fault conditions, the parameters of the grounding system, and the surrounding conditions of the grounding system. A grounding system state evaluation model was proposed, and a three-layer grounding system state evaluation structure system was constructed based on expert evaluation, grounding system design rules, and operating standards, including 4 secondary indicators and 10 tertiary indicators. A mathematical analysis was conducted on the established state evaluation system based on the Analytic Hierarchy Process, and the weights of each indicator were determined, which providing ideas and methods for the evaluation and assessment of the grounding system state.

articleTitle: Research on the Integrated Operation Platform of Daqing Oilfield Numerical Simulation Software
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Daqing Oilfield has not only independently developed the primary simulator for chemical flooding numerical simulation software but has also created an integrated platform for pre and post-processing. This platform is currently being promoted and applied in the oilfield, significantly enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of numerical simulations. This article primarily introduces the module division and basic functions of the integrated platform for pre- and post-processing in chemical flooding numerical simulation at Daqing Oilfield, aligning each function with real-world conditions to facilitate more proficient and precise use of the software by technical personnel.

articleTitle: Target and Interference Signal Recognition Method for FM Proximity Detector Based on Multidimensional Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In response to the anti-interference problem faced by FM proximity detectors, this paper proposes an accurate identification method for target and interference signals based on multidimensional feature fusion for forwarded interference. By analyzing the working principle of detection, target echo characteristics, and detector response under interference, feature parameters of detector echo signals are extracted. Support vector machines are used to classify samples and complete the classification and recognition of targets and interference. Through verification in this article, the classification accuracy of this method can reach 99%, which is a recognition method that can greatly improve the anti-interference ability of short-range detectors.

articleTitle: Research on Asynchronous Motor Vector Control System Based on Reconstructed Motor Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Due to its multivariable, strong coupling, and nonlinearity, asynchronous motors are commonly used in vector control models as voltage and current models. However, due to the addition of a series integrator in the voltage model, there are problems such as pure integral saturation and zero drift; Meanwhile, the accuracy of the current model is greatly affected by the measured rotor angular velocity. In response to the above issues, this article proposes a reconstructed motor model that introduces the current model into the voltage model, effectively complementing the two motor models, which can effectively solve many of the above problems and improve the accuracy of asynchronous motor vector control. In addition, the traditional three-level inverter SVPWM control adopts a 36 sector seven segment modulation method, which involves a large amount of trigonometric function operation and coordinate transformation. This paper proposes a simplified sector model modulation strategy, which significantly reduces the computational complexity compared to the 36 sector control method. Finally, The MATLAB/Simulink simulation platform was built to verify the correctness of the system control principle based on experiments.

articleTitle: Rapid Establishment of 3D Geological Model Based on Blender Software
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This article uses Blender three-dimensional modeling software, through its own functional modules such as subdivision modifier, displacement modifier, and Boolean modifier, and through operation processes such as import, stretch, extrusion, smoothing, scaling, and mapping, to create a model based on nearby ALOS-DEM elevation data, Google satellite images, electromagnetic detection, seismic survey profiles, modern seismic and other data quickly established a three-dimensional geological model within a depth range of 20km. Blender software has shown obvious efficiency and stability in the establishment process of this 3D model, which fully demonstrates that the software has wide applicability and potential in the field of 3D model establishment.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Auxiliary Tool for Substation Graph&Model Generation in Power System based on Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the main connection mode and characteristics of the power grid, the image recognition technology is used to study and realize the automatic auxiliary generation tool of the primary diagram of the power substation. By extracting the target substation electrical elements and connection relationships from the original PNG file of the substation diagram, the main transformer, bus bar and interval components are constructed, and the layout and wiring are completed using the typical wiring method. According to the common information model standard, the layout equipment annotation and measurement information are automatically associated to assist the drawing of the primary diagram of the substation. From a technical level, it assists the power grid automation personnel in the operation and maintenance of the diagram model. The effectiveness of this method has been verified through specific engineering applications.

articleTitle: Method for Establishing a North Reference for Azimuth Extraction Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The azimuth extraction device, a multi-point positioning and aiming equipment, calculates the relative orientation of the device by measuring the coordinates of marked points with a total station. It establishes a north reference using dual-satellite positioning antenna orientation technology to determine the north orientation of the device, achieving precise aiming<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. This paper first introduces the scheme for extracting the axis of the azimuth extraction device and establishes measurement targets parallel to the axis. It elaborates on the technology of using a total station to measure coordinates for calculating relative orientation and using dual-satellite positioning to establish a north reference. The system measurement error of the device is analyzed, and the measurement accuracy is verified. Simulation tests show that the proposed measurement system construction method meets the precise aiming requirements of the azimuth extraction device, with an azimuth accuracy better than 43″ and an elevation accuracy better than 16.6″.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Extraction of Multi-source Data Based on Large Language Models
