publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: OBJECTIVE In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of key information extraction from multi-source data, this study proposes an automatic extraction method based on large language models. METHODS The entity and relation were extracted from the electronic records, cases and literature data by using the dialogue mode of large language model, and the extracted results were compared with those of common deep learning models. The model with the best effect was selected, the triplet form required for knowledge graph was generated by taking liver disease as an example for empirical study, and was visually displayed by Neo4j. RESULTS Large language model GLM-4 and BERT-BiLSTM-CRF, UIE were used for entity extraction and relation extraction respectively. The experimental results showed that GLM-4 had the best extraction effect, F1 value of entity extraction was 0.76, F1 value of relation extraction was 0.64. 2272 liver disease data were extracted by the model to obtain the liver disease knowledge graph, with a total of 9186 triples. CONCLUSION This study explores a path of knowledge acquisition based on large language model for multi-source data, which improves the accuracy and efficiency, has strong practical value, and provides a new idea and method for clinical research.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Technology in Smart Metering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the development of technologies such as cloud computing, big data, and artificial intelligence, traditional measurement urgently needs to adapt to the changes and enter the digital age through digital transformation to achieve smart measurement. Smart measurement is an important foundation for serving the development of the digital economy, safeguarding people's livelihood, supporting urban governance, and supporting industrial development. It proactively deploys digital measurement technologies and actively explores the implementation paths and difficulties of smart measurement. This article takes the application of digital technology in the 5G smart management system of the measurement sample library as an example to analyze its principles and usage scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Incremental Costs and Incremental Benefits of ASPICE Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: ASPICE model is introduced by more and more automotive software suppliers to improve the automotive software development process. The purpose is to improve the software quality by standardizing the automotive software development process. Due to the particularity of the software development process, there are many uncertainties in the process improvement, and the final result of the improvement will be affected by many factors. Based on the research of incremental costs and incremental benefits of ASPICE model, this paper proposes a method that combines return on investment and interpretive structural model, which provides a new reference for the evaluation of the implementation process and result of ASPICE model.

articleTitle: Rapid Non-Destructive Detection of Fruit Sugar Content Based on Nir and Lstm_Attention Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of destroying fruits in traditional fruit sugar content detection, a new, nondestructive fruit sugar content detection method based on near infrared spectroscopy(NIR) and deep learning was proposed in this paper. In order to reduce the negative impact of noise and scattering effects, three spectral preprocessing methods, Normalization, Baseline, and SG smoothing, were compared to determine the optimal method. Compared with the low prediction performance disadvantages of traditional chemometric methods such as PLSR, PCR and SVM, a new model based on LSTM and self-attention mechanism was proposed to significantly improve the accuracy of sugar content prediction. The results show that SG smoothing was a better preprocessing method than Normalization and Baseline correction. The model of LSTM combined with selfattention achieved R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of 0.97 and 0.92 on the training and test sets, and RMSE of 0.27 and 0.70, respectively, which was significantly better than PLSR, PCR, SVM, and also outperformed the LSTM-only model with R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of 0.96 and 0.89, and RMSE of 0.43 and 0.96. Therefore, the method based on NIR and LSTM_self-attention can achieve non-destructive and accurate detection of fruit sugar content, which provides a new idea to detect sugar content.

articleTitle: LSTM Combinatorial Prediction Model Based on Global Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimizatione
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Many studies have attempted to use artificial neural networks for data prediction in various industries. However, the optimization of these neural networks is influenced by experimental errors and operators lacking prior knowledge, as well as by the initial values and the size of the search space. In this paper, we propose a method that combines particle swarm optimization (PSO) with LSTM networks to automatically determine hyperparameters, addressing the problem of complex network topology and the challenge of selecting numerous hyperparameters in LSTM. We design and improve a Global Adaptive PSO algorithm (GAPSO), and employ the GAPSO algorithm for hyperparameter optimization of LSTM models (GAPSO-LSTM) to enhance the prediction accuracy and robustness of the LSTM model algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate that the GAPSO-LSTM algorithm not only reduces errors but also achieves higher prediction accuracy in medium and long-term prediction scenarios.

articleTitle: Application and research of adaptive architecture data acquisition technology in metrology and testing projects
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the continuous deepening of digital transformation in laboratories, the digitisation of original records has become a key to improving testing efficiency and data accuracy. However, due to the different formats of original records from project to project, the traditional fixed-template data collection methods can no longer meet the current requirements. This paper proposes an adaptive architecture for original records based on metrological test projects, which aims to achieve efficient data collection and management through flexible data collection templates and a data structure designer. By analysing existing data collection systems, this paper designs an adaptive data collection template and combines it with JSON data matching and processing procedures to improve the usability and analytical efficiency of laboratory data.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of monitoring and metering system for photovoltaic inverter based on core converter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The current monitoring system for photovoltaic inverter has the following problems: the installation of inverter monitoring device is difficult, which requires power outage, and the commonly used wired or dual-mode communication can not achieve real-time two-way and high-quality communication. Aiming at these problems, this paper designs a monitoring and metering system of photovoltaic inverter based on core converter. In this system, the core converter acts as a gateway, the downlink communicates with the inverter, and the uplink is divided into two parts, which communicate with the original 4G module and the 4G module in the metering system respectively. This paper focuses on the modular hardware design of the core converter and the software application development based on MQTT. The system can monitor the inverter in a concise and efficient way, which is helpful to deepen and improve the application of the monitoring system for photovoltaic grid connected inverter.

articleTitle: Surface Defect Detection of Reflective Plating Bath Workpiece by Enhanced Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: To address the issues of low efficiency, high costs, incorrect detection, and missed defects in the manual visual inspection of electroplated sanitary ware, an image acquisition environment was designed and constructed based on the optical characteristics of electroplated components. This setup significantly enhances the quality of image acquisition. An upsampling multi-scale bilateral filtering algorithm is proposed for image preprocessing, effectively reducing noise while retaining edge details of defects across different scales. Additionally, an improved DoG edge detection operator is introduced to enhance the extraction of small defect edges.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors and Research on Strategy Optimization of BDS Satellite Clock Bias Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The current research work on GNSS satellite clock bias prediction models and methods is very rich, but the research on the optimal accuracy of GNSS satellite clock bias prediction is not deep enough. In view of this problem, this paper constructs a satellite clock bias prediction model and analyzes the comprehensive influence of fitting time, prediction time, orbital height and satellite clock characteristics on the prediction accuracy. In this paper, the BDS satellite clock bias product provided by IGS are used to analyze and predict the optimal strategy. The results show that the better the performance of the satellite clock, the higher the prediction accuracy. The optimal fitting time of the clock bias prediction is related to the satellite's orbit. The BDS satellite clock bias has low prediction accuracy when the fitting time is 12h~24h, and stable prediction accuracy when it is 36h~108h, both of which are better than 0.5ns. The fitting time is 4 times and 7 times the orbital period of the MEO satellite (48h and 84h), and the prediction accuracy is the highest, and the prediction accuracy within 1h is better than 0.3ns.

articleTitle: Research of Ship Trajectory and Navigation Behavior Characteristics Based on CALS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This study examines the navigation trajectory data of over AIS ships in the Chinese sea area during 2021, proposes a CNN - Attention - LSTM neural network deep learning algorithm for constructing a predictive and early warning model for navigation trajectories based on ship navigation trajectory training, and introduces the sliding window algorithm to effectively address concept drift in streaming data, wherein the underlying patterns of data change with time. Furthermore, real - time detection of abnormal navigation states is achieved. Additionally, ship behavior abnormalities are categorized into three groups and ten types based on AIS information parameters related to navigation trajectories. This approach successfully addresses the challenge of detecting and providing early warnings for abnormal navigation trajectories while offering valuable support for safe navigation and military decision - making.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of LangChain-based Chatbot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This paper takes the digital materials such as product data manual and videos as a local knowledge base (LKB), and utilizes the learning ability of large-scale language models (LLMs) to construct a chatbot. It can be used for training new employees or as a technical assistant for on-site maintenance personnel. In addition to providing one-on-one answers to employees through dialogue, it can also search for videos based on keywords and locate relevant information in the video. The LLM driving the chatbot can be either a mainstream online LLM or a locally deployed LLM. The LKB will have priority in the conversation and will only access external models or network resources when the answer cannot be searched from the LKB.

articleTitle: Implementation of Spot Detection System Based on Four-Quadrant Detector
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In wireless laser communication systems, acquisition, pointing, and tracking (ATP) technology is a crucial research area, and spot detection technology is a key component of the ATP. This paper implemented a spot detection system based on four-quadrant detector, which can mitigate errors in signal capture and spot localization throughout the laser transmission process. The system includes an optical reception unit, a four-quadrant detector, electrical signal processing, and a signal acquisition unit. Offset displacement of the spot is characterized by acquired voltage signal. Experimental results indicate that the system can fulfill the spot detection and measurement error is less than 2%. The results provide a theory foundation for practical application of laser tracking.

articleTitle: Adaptive Epidemic Routing Based on Buffer Management for Dtns
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Delay Tolerant Networks (DTNs) are proposed to cope with the intermittent disruption and variable long delay conditions, which maybe caused by mobility or energy and other cases. In order to transmit messages by the possible chances, a novel adaptive epidemic routing based on networks state and node buffer management is proposed to solve the challenging routing issues in DTNs. The multiqueue buffer management policy is proposed to cope with the insufficient storage space of DTNs nodes, and the utility function is used to sort the messages in every queue so as to make use of each contact chance more fully. The adaptive forwarding methods are used in accordance with different queue and networks state. The proposed scheme can reduce network overload ratio and transmission latency. Meanwhile, the scheme can increase delivery probability ratio and provide Quality of Service. From the simulation results, it shows that the proposed approach is able to achieve better performance in the delivery ratio, network overhead and transmission delay compared to the traditional DTN’s routing schemes in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Data Extension Application Technology for 3D Digital Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In order to serve the general contracting project of thermal power plants, break through the "drawing calculation" mode that exists in the engineering settlement stage, and accelerate the digital transformation of engineering construction, based on 3D digital models, carry out the research and development of extended application technology for 3D digital collaborative data. Cost control engineers directly read design data through 3D cost control software, automatically perform hierarchical analysis and type selection on complex models of various specialties, efficiently and accurately extract installation specialties The engineering quantity data of the civil engineering profession is directly used for engineering quantity estimation and settlement after pricing.

articleTitle: The Collaborative Parallel Calculation Method for Carbon Emission Factors in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The carbon emission factor of the power system is the main method of carbon emission analysis to support the establishment of a power carbon emission accounting system. The research direction is to achieve precise and dynamic calculation of carbon emission factors for time-sharing and zoning electricity. To solve the problems of large data volume and long calculation time in cross regional computing, this paper studies a collaborative parallel calculation method for carbon emission factors in power systems. This article first introduces the theoretical system of regional electricity carbon emission factor degree, and introduces an algorithm for regional electricity carbon emission factor model based on carbon emission flow. Then, the data exchange mechanism and concurrent scheduling technology for parallel collaborative calculation of carbon emission factors were studied, and the node power carbon emission factors were calculated through hierarchical and domain based methods. Finally, based on the experimental results, the collaborative parallel computing method can greatly reduce computational time and improve computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Threat Detection of SQL Injection Attacks in Large Scale Web Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Web applications are susceptible to SQL conventional injection, second-order injection, or blind injection attacks during operation, bring security threats to web system data, user privacy, or sensitive data. To reduce the impact of SQL injection on system vulnerability attacks, a fuzzy testing vulnerability detection technology for web applications and servers is proposed. A fuzzy testing SQL injection vulnerability detection model framework is established. The information collection module and fuzzy detection mod ule of the vulnerability detection framework are used, and keyword encoding, mixed case encoding, and structured query language (SQL) statement annotations are used to complete parameter queries and hierarchical detection of level 0, level 1, and level 2 vulner abilities through detection processes such as restructuring and bypassing. Finally, an experimental environment is built using soft ware and hardware such as ASP. NET, Microsoft Visual Studio, and IIS server to demonstrate the SQL injection vulnerability detection model based on fuzzy testing technology. The simulation results show that the SQL injection vulnerability detection model based on fuzzy testing method, compared to the SQL injection attack detection method of web application source code based on pro gram slicing technology, is validated in different levels of vulnerability detection. The detection effect is better (reaching over 90%).

articleTitle: Basic Laws and Control of Ground Aerodynamic Effects of High-Speed Electric Multiple Unit Trains
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The air pressure distribution inside and outside the equipment cabin at the bottom of a high-speed electric multiple unit (EMU) train car body and near the bogie and the evolution laws of aerodynamic effects during operation and passing in open lines and tunnels are studied using an overall vehicle line test. This included the air pressure changes and evolution laws of the inside and outside of the vehicle when a high-speed train passed through tunnels at different speeds and during passing in and outside of tunnels. The maximum atmospheric pressure near the head section 3 when the car body intersected in the tunnel at a speed of 350 km/h was 5800 Pa, which provides a basic test basis for analyzing the stress condition of the bottom structure of the car body and for further the subsequent control and optimization of the bottom structure and the hanging device of the equipment.

articleTitle: Summary of research on stability control strategy of new energy grid-connected inverter under weak gird condition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the introduction of some policies to encourage the development of photovoltaic power generation, the proportion of installed capacity of the new energy power generation system in the public power grid has been increasing, making partial public grid gradually change to a weak power grid. The non-ideal characteristics of the weak power grid conditions will cause mutual influence among the inverter and the public grid, thus affecting the stable operation of the public grid and the reliable work of inverter. In summary, first of all, a series of scientific research achievements on the stability control of inverters in the condition of weak gird are reviewed, the basic principles of current strategies and methods are described, and their strengths and weaknesses are summarized and analyzed. Finally, the future prospects direction is prospected in combination with the current trend of power system construction. In order to overcome the impact of extremely weak power grid conditions caused by the high permeability of photovoltaic power generation in the future, the current technical achievements and research direction still need to be further explored.

articleTitle: Damage Detection of Complex Structure Using Alif and Sample Percentile
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In order to identify structural damage patterns directly from the structural response, a structural damage detection method using adaptive local iterative filtering (ALIF) and sample percentile is presented. For the method, the structural vibration response is decomposed into a series of steady signal components by ALIF. Then the percentile of each component signal is calculated as the damage characteristic parameters. The relationship between the damage degree and the characteristic parameters is established. Finally, the characteristic parameters are input to the probabilistic neural network (PNN) classifier to detect the damage states. The experimental results indicate that the method proposed in this paper is effective in identifying structural damage.

articleTitle: Research on Power Grid Flow Section Completion Algorithm Based on Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In order to solver the problem of partial missing in power grid flow section data, this article proposes a transformer-based power grid flow section completion algorithm. Based on the classic Transformer model, the proposed method incorporates specific modifications to both the model architecture and the loss function to better accommodate the unique requirements of power grid flow section completion. The proposed model utilizes historical data matrices of active power, reactive power, voltage, and current as inputs to predict the matrix of current active power, facilitating the imputation of missing active power values. The model's performance was evaluated using comprehensive sectional data from a regional power grid, spanning the entire year of 2023. Following an extensive optimization process, the model demonstrated a robust performance with a root mean square error (RMSE) of 33.889, demonstrating its efficacy in accurate data completion.

articleTitle: Study of the Control Strategy of a Three-Phase Three-Wire Shunt Power Active Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This paper analyses the advantages and disadvantages of common APF control strategies, selects the three-phase, three-wire APF as the research object, and proposes a variable structure current tracking control strategy based on input-output linearization and a DC voltage stabilization control strategy based on higher-order sliding mode control (HOSMC) based on the analysis of its basic structure and harmonic compensation principle, analyses the control of the DC voltage controller and the compensation current controller in detail, and establishes its mathematical model. The idea of the DC voltage controller and the compensated current controller is analyzed in detail, their mathematical models are established, the selection of relevant controller parameters is completed, and the implementation method of the control strategy is discussed. Finally, a simulation model of the system is established to verify the effectiveness of the above control strategy in the harmonic compensation of the power supply current and the stabilization of the DC voltage, and the good anti-interference ability and robustness of the control strategy are also verified.

articleTitle: Estimating the Health State of Lithium-Ion Batteries Under Random Operating Conditions Using Statistical Methods and Data-Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The development of electrochemical energy storage technologies represented by lithium batteries is crucial for achieving the electrification of transportation and the large-scale development of new energy sources. However, lithium ions undergo a degradation process during use, making it a significant challenge to accurately assess the health status of batteries in real-time through online data. This study utilizes statistical methods to extract features that reflect battery aging information under random discharge conditions. By employing correlation analysis and random forest feature analysis methods, key features are identified through feature selection. Subsequently, the effectiveness of these features is demonstrated through four different data-driven methods. Finally, the contribution and influence of different feature sources are analysed through degradation experiments. The results indicate that statistical features can effectively eliminate data fluctuations under random conditions, and when combined with the multilayer perceptron method, optimal State of Health (SOH) estimation can be achieved.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Test Research on Large Prototype Francis Turbine Cavitation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In order to fully obtain the cavitation characteristics of the large Francis turbine, the acoustic emission sensors were used to carry out the prototype turbine cavitation test. The acoustic emission signals of the typical measuring points (head cover and draft tube man door) were collected when the turbine was under multiple operating conditions. The real energy characteristics and their variation rules of the turbine under different operating conditions were obtained. The results show that with the change of the cavitation coefficient of the turbine, the energy of the acoustic emission signals collected from the turbine head cover and the draft tube man door changes obviously and regularly from no cavitation, cavitation inception to complete cavitation. The measuring point of the draft tube man door is more obvious than the head cover. It can be seen from the analysis that the acoustic emission energy of the draft tube man door measuring point is relatively stable in the range of 0MW to 480MW, and it shows an upward trend in the range of 480MW to 600MW. This is completely consistent with the theoretical analysis of the cavitation characteristics of the turbine. It can be seen that it is feasible to determine the degree of cavitation by selecting the appropriate measuring point position and measuring the relationship between cavitation noise and cavitation coefficient during turbine operation through high-frequency acoustic emission signals. The acoustic emission method is a sensitive and accurate detection method, which is suitable for determining the initial point of cavitation and the relative strength of cavitation.

articleTitle: The collision detection algorithm of industrial robot based on recursive neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor real-time and low accuracy of the existing industrial robot collision detection technology, a collision detection method based on recurrent neural network (RNN) and its variant long and short-term memory (LSTM) network is proposed. Through the deep learning technology, this method directly extracts features from the robot sensor data, learns the time series data during the robot motion in real time, captures the dynamic changes of the motion trajectory, and realizes the real-time monitoring and prediction of the collision risk. A dataset of multiple operation scenarios was constructed, based on which the LSTM model was trained. The experimental results show that the model is better than the traditional rule-based methods in terms of real-time and accuracy of collision detection, which can accurately predict collisions with very short detection delays and reduce the detection time by about 30% to 40%. Meanwhile, the method reduces the dependence on complex kinetic models and improves the robustness of the collision detection system.

articleTitle: Salmon Quality Fast Non-Destructive Detection Based on Computer Vision and Mobilevit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: To address the drawbacks of complexity and time consumption in conventional salmon quality detection methods, a detection method based on computer vision and deep learning was proposed, and the freshness, fat content, and tightness of salmon were quickly, non-destructively and accurately detected in this paper. In detecting salmon fat content, a thresholding-based approach was utilized to leverage the color contrast between salmon fat and flesh. To improve the local perception limitations of conventional CNN models, self-attention was employed to learn global features of images. Consequently, a lightweight model called MobileViT based on CNN and Transformer was introduced to detect salmon quality. Results show that MobileViT achieved better prediction than models like MobileNet, ResNet. The accuracy on salmon freshness detection reached 88% and 85% for training and test set. For salmon tightness, it reached 92% and 87% respectively. This 1.3M parameters model can be deployed on mobile devices to enable fast, non-destructive and accurate salmon quality detection, helping consumers quickly identify fresh and premium salmon.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Portable and Re-configurable Unmanned Aerial Vehicle(UAV) Detection Radar Based on ADRV9040 and MPSoC
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: A portable and re-configurable Unmanned Aerial Vehicle(UAV) detection Radar with battlefield as the main usage environment was designed and implemented using the ADRV9040 broadband transceiver chip and the Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC chip as the core hardware.The system consists of a host computer and a Radar front-end, which are connected by optical fiber. The Radar front-end is composed of an MPSoC motherboard, an ADRV9040 RF sub-board, T/R components and phased array antenna. The system can be used to detect low, slow and small targets such as DJI Phantom 4 UAV within a range of 300 meters to 2000 meters. The experimental results show that it has a high detection probability and range measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Application and Optimization of Deep Learning in Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, image recognition, as an important branch of computer vision, has shown great application potential in various fields such as security monitoring, autonomous driving, and medical image analysis. Traditional image recognition methods rely on manually designed feature extractors and classifiers, which are difficult to handle complex and variable image data. The emergence of deep learning technology, especially the wide application of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), has greatly promoted the progress of image recognition technology. This paper aims to review the application status of deep learning in image recognition and explore optimization strategies to provide effective strategies and directions for the wide application of deep learning in image recognition.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Wardrobe System Based on IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In view of the traditional wardrobe can only be used to store a single feature, the intelligent wardrobe system based on the IoT technology is designed. The system integrates the IoT technology, sensor technology and communication technology to achieve wardrobe dehumidification and mildew prevention, air temperature and humidity detection, intelligent lighting, intelligent wear and other functions. The system solves the basic problems of inconvenient wardrobe arrangement and difficult to find clothes in users' lives, and provides users with weather information and daily wear suggestions, providing services in all aspects. Through the physical verification, the dehumidification heating effect of the system is obvious, which can improve the internal environment of the wardrobe, and improve the efficiency of taking and placing clothes.

articleTitle: Simulation of Short Circuit Fault in 66kV Offshore Wind Power Collecting System and Analysis of Electrical Wear of High-Voltage Circuit-Breakers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: High voltage circuit breakers are one of the key equipment in offshore wind power collection systems. The impulse current generated by three-phase short circuit or single-phase ground short circuit faults on the line will directly affect the electrical reliability of the high-voltage circuit-breaker contacts. This article establishes a simulation model for the 66kV offshore wind power collection system based on Matlab/Simulink, simulates and analyzes the short-circuit impulse current at different short-circuit faults and fault locations, and calculates the relative electrical wear and breaking times of the circuit breaker using the evaluation methods of contact relative electrical wear and relative electrical life. Simulation calculations show that the relative electrical wear of contacts is related to the failure type and the location of the failure point. Short-circuit impulse current is one of the direct factors affecting the electrical wear and its reliability of circuit-breaker contacts.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Wind Speed on Wind Turbine Power Generation in the Background of New Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the vigorous promotion of new power systems, the high proportion of new energy integration into the power grid poses serious challenges to the stability of power system operation. To discuss the impact of wind speed on the power generation of wind turbines, this article starts with the analysis of wind speed and power generation data in multiple scenarios, and analyzes and studies the actual situation of power generation in onshore wind farms. Firstly, a mathematical expression was established for wind speed and wind turbine power generation, and the factors affecting wind turbine power generation were analyzed. Secondly, based on the operational data of individual wind turbines at two stations, Zhongmen Wind Farm in Fujian Province and Minghe Wind Farm in Henan Province, the relationship between wind speed and power generation in high wind speed provinces and low wind speed provinces was studied, and solutions were proposed in combination with the problems. Finally, through data analysis results, the relationship between wind speed and power generation was verified, and the following conclusion was drawn: the higher the wind speed, the greater the power generation may not necessarily be, that is, there is not a completely positive correlation between wind speed and power generation.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Smart Power-assisted Seats
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: As the physical functions of the elderly decline or joint movements become inflexible, intelligent power-assisted chairs can help the elderly get up, sit down smoothly, and perform emergency call functions through voice or manipulation. Most of the power-assisted chairs in the existing market are automatically advanced first, which have disadvantages such as being bulky, having excessive cost, and poor experience. This research uses the theory of human mechanical engineering and the economy of use to design the size of power-assisted chairs for the elderly. The design requirements analyze the usage situation of elderly seats to obtain functional design requirements. Eventually, an intelligent power-assisted chair for the elderly with a simple structure, comfort, lightness, and economy is designed.

articleTitle: Research on image classification and recognition technology based on depth learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: A new image classification algorithm based on multi-feature extraction and improved SVM classifier is analyzed theoretically and numerically. Image object classification and detection are two basic problems in computer vision, the key is how to fully mine a large amount of redundant information, and on this basis to make effective feature supplement, thus, the classification accuracy of the image is reduced. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved SVM algorithm by combining image classification and synthesis technology. This paper proposes a video sequence segmentation method based on PCA, which can describe the content characteristics of the image comprehensively, and use PCA to extract conversion features and eliminate redundancy, the experimental results show that the algorithm is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: An Evolutionary Algorithm with Infeasible Information and Adaptation of Vector Angle for Many-objective Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Because of the important role of infeasible information in solving multi-objective optimization problems by evolutionary algorithms, this paper uses infeasible information to improve the priority and selection probability of infeasible solutions with good diversity. The comparison and search of feasible solutions are done using the adaptive reference vector and scalar function. Combined with the maximum-vector-angle-first and worse-elimination principles, the convergence of population is achieved by using the converged infeasible solutions. Experiments show that our algorithm can effectively balance convergence and diversity.

articleTitle: 3D Scene Collision DetectionTechnology Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Aiming at the slow collision detection speed and poor accuracy in complex virtual scenes, a new collision detection technology based on convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed. Using the powerful feature extraction and recognition ability of CNN, we directly learn the relevant features of collision detection from 3D scene data, avoiding the complex geometric calculation and preprocessing steps in traditional methods. The designed network uses 3D convolution layer and pooling layer to effectively process 3D spatial information, and optimize the computational efficiency and parameter number of the model through deeply separable convolution and bottleneck modules. The introduction of multiscale feature-fusion techniques enhances the robustness of the model to scale changes and incorporates attention mechanisms to highlight potential collision regions. Experimental results on multiple standard 3D datasets show that the proposed method outperforms existing collision detection algorithms in terms of both detection speed and accuracy. Especially when dealing with complex scenes and dynamic environments, it shows higher detection sensitivity and lower false alarm rate. It provides a new technical path for the field of 3D scene collision detection, and also provides important technical support for security monitoring and interaction in applications such as intelligent systems and virtual reality.

articleTitle: Research on Self Discharge Characteristics of Lithium ion Batteries under Different Storage Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: Self discharge plays a crucial role in maintaining the lifespan and capacity of lithium-ion batteries. This study investigated the effects of storage conditions (including storage time, storage temperature and state of charge-SOC) on self-discharge performance and capacity attenuation of ternary lithium batteries. Through a 180-day storage test, the self-discharge behavior and capacity degradation mechanism of the batteries under different factors were revealed. The self discharge characteristics of batteries are most evident in the early stages of storage, with the self discharge rate reaching its peak within the first 60 days and gradually slowing down to reach its lowest point at 120 days. As the aging of the battery deepens, the self discharge rate will increase again. In addition, storage temperature is a key factor affecting self-discharge and capacity degradation. The irreversible degradation rate of battery capacity is significantly higher at 60 ℃ than at 25 ℃ and 45 ℃, showing a monotonic increase in self discharge rate with increasing temperature. Batteries with high SOC exhibit faster capacity degradation after long term storage. In addition, the HPPC test method was used to analyze the variation characteristics of the internal resistance Rs of the battery during the storage process, which provided important data support for understanding the degradation mechanism of the battery performance under storage conditions. In summary, this study not only deepens the understanding of ternary lithium battery storage performance, but also provides a scientific basis for optimizing battery storage strategy and extending battery life.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Automatic Detection of load cells
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: This article explores the application of artificial intelligence in load cells detection, analyzes how AI technology can improve measurement accuracy and efficiency, automate detection processes, and achieve real-time monitoring, fault prediction, and alarm. By summarizing existing research and practical cases, the application and future development direction of AI in the field of automatic detection of load cells are discussed.

articleTitle: Automatic generation method of shirt sample based on parameter control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: In order to quickly generate clothing samples that conform to individual body shapes and solve the problems of cumbersome customization process and long production cycle, taking men's shirts as an example, we use parametric expressions to control the size of the sample structure and geometric constraints to control the shape of the sample, construct a parametric structure model of the sample, and drive the original paper sample to become a new paper sample by assigning different values to the parameters. At the same time, the regression model relationship between human body data and sample size is established to provide the specification size for the parametric structural model to be used for board making, and finally a complete digital customization system of human body data-sample size-sample generation is formed, which provides a technical reference for realizing large-scale personalized apparel customization.

articleTitle: An Identification Method of Distributed Multiple Harmonic Sources Based on Joint Approximate Diagonalization of Eigenmatrices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: All the existing harmonic source location methods require harmonic impedance parameters and network topology as prior information. However, it is difficult to accurately obtain network parameters under non-fundamental frequency conditions in actual power systems, which makes the above methods difficult to apply in practice. Therefore, this paper proposes a harmonic source identification method without using harmonic impedance parameters. Firstly, all harmonic source signals in the network are solved by the blind source separation algorithm based on multi-point harmonic measurements. Then, separate and recover the harmonic source current on both sides of the point of common coupling (PCC) based on the single harmonic measurements of each load node. Finally, by matching the correlation between the source signal separation results of multi-point measurement data and the separation results derived from single-point measurement data, the position of harmonic sources can be accurately located. The effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method are verified by simulation cases.

articleTitle: Design of Stroller System Based on STM32 And Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: STM32 and fuzzy control based strollers contain a wide range of sensors, microcontrollers, wireless communication devices, camera modules and systems that integrate various advanced technologies. This system can continue to provide parents with a convenient and safe way to take care of the baby, while providing parents with real-time data about the safety and comfort of the baby, such as: temperature and humidity sensors can monitor and adjust the environment of the stroller; The camera module can monitor the baby’s status in real time and whether there are strangers near the threat; The ESP32 module allows the device to exchange data with Huawei IoT platform. Through the mobile App, parents can remotely operate and monitor the baby’s status, reducing the difficulty of nursing. The Kalman filter processing for the data collected by the sensor can reduce the occurrence of wrong data, so as to reduce the fluctuation of the data and make the data closer to the real value. For the stroller environment perception system, fuzzy control is used to adjust the environmental condition and make the baby feel more comfortable. In short, the experiment shows that the stroller system can improve the experience of parents taking care of babies and make it more convenient to care for babies.

articleTitle: A Carbon Emission Factors Calculating Method based Privacy Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: With the development of low-carbon transformation in the power system, using electricity to calculate carbon has become the main method of carbon emission factor accounting. The management and security issues of electricity carbon data have become prominent. Electricity carbon data includes a large amount of user privacy information. How to protect sensitive information and prevent vulnerabilities and tampering has become a hot research topic. This article studies the data privacy protection requirements of carbon emission calculation algorithms, conducts internal and external exchange and calculation of electric carbon data based on federated learning, and uses privacy protection algorithms such as data anonymization and homomorphic encryption for desensitization and encryption of electric carbon data. Based on a secure multi-party computing platform, this article conducts privacy calculation verification, fully demonstrating the security, compliance, and effectiveness of privacy protection for carbon emission factor calculation. On the basis of ensuring the accuracy of carbon emission factor calculation, it reduces the risk of data leakage privacy.

articleTitle: Design of Emergency Management Information System Based on Injury Assessment Report
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore an accident rescue system based on Internet platform, in order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of accident rescue and provide new ideas for people to use emergency management online cooperation system. Based on the triage strategy used in mass casualty events (MCI), the system establishes an emergency rescue system by analyzing the cycle of events. The system integrates mobile device, server terminal, rescue center terminal and Internet platform for offline item management, providing support and collaboration opportunities for injured, survivors, rescue command center, rescue team, triage team, on-site medical team and other involved parties. The system consists of four key components: Mobile device, Server, Rescue center and Offline items management. It can integrate the injury database based on various current operation stages and make SOP (Standard Operation Program) for pre-hospital use of injury database for public without medical background and emergency dispatch. Taking trauma as an example, the possible injury classification is introduced, the technical route of SOP production is introduced, and the video of telephone guidance CPR is used to show the effect that can be achieved, and the START triage and injury evaluation report are realized by Android programming. In discussion section, the accuracy of the simple triage algorithm at this stage and the case of SOP in the implementation process. The advantages of the system include improving the quality of on-site first aid and may be used for counting the total amount of resources in emergency management and timely allocation of resources. Limitations of the system include the lack of actual MCI event testing and comparison and the use of self-created injury classifications, as well as the lack of use of injury databases currently in operation, including ICD diagnostic codes. Limitations of the system on the other side include failure to test the system using MCI exercises or emergency management exercises, insufficient testing of the accuracy of wearable devices, and insufficient statistics on the correlation between medical resources and triage results.

articleTitle: Short-Term EVs Charging Load Prediction Under Low-quality Data Environment Based on GRU-GAN-GOA-MKELM Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: The precise forecasting of electric vehicles (EVs) load can provide reference for assessing the influence of EVs on the electricity network and optimizing the operation and allocation of the electricity network. Nevertheless, as the recorded dataset of the EV battery charging stations are difficult to collect, obtaining accurate prediction results with scarce EVs load data is challenging. On the one hand, the missing data exert great influence on forecasting values. On the other hand, a forecasting framework with superior precision should be trained with large amount of data. Aiming at realizing high accuracy EVs load prediction results utilizing scarce data, a data generation approach in terms of a generative adversarial network (GAN) is put forward. This method can generate high quality data from the scarce initial data to enhance prediction precision. Additionally, the prediction framework is established on the basis of the multi-kernel extreme learning machine (MKELM) combining poly and RBF kernel functions, parameters of which are optimally chosen via the grasshopper optimization algorithm (GOA). Through comparing with the five comparison models and three data generation methods, the validity and feasibility of the established EVs load prediction framework is verified.

articleTitle: Optimization and Verification of the SWP Model Based on Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: To establish a Sleep-Wake Prediction (SWP) model suitable for Chinese civil aviation flight crews and improve the algorithm construction of the biological mathematical model of fatigue, providing an algorithmic foundation for the crew fatigue risk management system. Based on deep learning methods, this paper constructs a modified Sleep-Wake Prediction model (MSWP) through the collection of large-scale sleep data of civil aviation flight crews in China. Subsequently, taking observed data, TPMA, and FAID as controls, statistical analysis methods such as Tamhane's T2 test are used to comparatively evaluate the effectiveness of MSWP. The results show that both MSWP and FAID are significantly superior to TPMA in terms of sleep-onset/wake-up time difference. MSWP has better sleep-onset time prediction success rates (68.2%) and wake-up time prediction success rates (70.6%). Moreover, the daily average sleep duration of MSWP (459.33±107.69) is closer to the observed data (474±210.23). Compared with TPMA and FAID, the sleep prediction accuracy of MSWP for Chinese civil aviation pilots has been significantly improved.

articleTitle: Enhancing Power Model Performance with Image Augmentation and Denoising Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Technology and Control Engineering (ACTCE)
abstract: High-quality power transmission business samples are crucial for training and optimizing power-related models. However, the current insufficient number of samples and the influence of various disturbing noises lead to significant differences in the quality of the samples, which triggers the problems of model underfitting, poor robustness and low recognition accuracy. To address the issue of insufficient sample quantity, this paper takes measures to expand the sample size before model training. By employing several common data augmentation methods and Poisson fusion techniques, the sample size has been successfully increased, facilitating better fusion of defect images with transmission line background images. This approach helps the model learn more comprehensively and enhances its generalization ability. Furthermore, to suppress noise in images, this paper has improved the DnCNN model for image denoising to enhance image quality. This step effectively reduces the interference of noise on model training and image analysis, improving the model’s ability to accurately capture image features. Experimental validation of these methods in this paper demonstrates their effectiveness in enhancing the model’s performance and stability. The combined application of these technical approaches is expected to provide more effective solutions for image processing and analysis in the electricity industry, thereby driving further development and innovation in the power sector.
